content.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
content.trans: 大家好，欢迎回到EnglishPod。我是Marco。

content.text: And my name is Catherine and today Marco, we're talking about something that I know you're a big fan of.
content.trans: 我是Catherine。Marco，今天我们要聊的话题，我知道你非常喜欢。

content.text: I am. We're talking about computer games, video games.
content.trans: 没错。我们要聊的是电脑游戏，电子游戏。

content.text: Woohoo! So yeah, we're going to be looking at some vocabulary and phrases related to computer games and video games.
content.trans: 芜湖！没错，我们将学习一些与电脑游戏和电子游戏相关的词汇和短语。

content.text: And this is actually a request from one of our users.
content.trans: 这其实是我们一位用户的请求。

content.text: So before we get started, we do have the name of the game that we're going to look at.
content.trans: 在开始之前，我们确实有一个今天要聊的游戏名字。

content.text: So let's listen to that in today's vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 让我们在今天的“词汇预览”中听一听。

content.text: Very vocabulary preview.
content.trans: 词汇预览。

content.text: Alright, so the game that we're going to preview today is called Counter Strike.
content.trans: 好的，今天我们要预览的游戏叫做反恐精英。

content.text: Okay, so first you have a strike or an attack. Then you have a Counter Strike.
content.trans: 好的，所以首先你有打击或攻击。然后你有《反恐英雄》。

content.text: So that's an opposite attack or something like that, right?
content.trans: 所以这是对立的攻击或类似的行动，对吗？

content.text: So it's a reaction to the first thing that happens.
content.trans: 所以这是对最初发生的事件的反应。

content.text: So you hit me and my Counter Strike is I hit you back.
content.trans: 所以你打了我，我的《反恐英雄》是你打回去了。

content.text: And this game is actually very, very popular all over the world because many players are able to compete at the same time.
content.trans: 这个游戏在全世界非常非常受欢迎，因为很多玩家可以同时竞技。

content.text: So it's a shooting game. You shoot each other.
content.trans: 这是一款射击游戏。你们互相射击。

content.text: You are the terrorists and then the other team is like the police or the army or whatever.
content.trans: 一方是恐怖分子，另一方就像是警察或军队之类的。

content.text: Wow, sounds really exciting.
content.trans: 哇，听起来真刺激。

content.text: Well, we're going to learn more about the specific vocab that goes with computer games and video games in a minute.
content.trans: 好吧，我们稍后将详细学习与电脑游戏和电子游戏相关的特定词汇。

content.text: But first let's take a listen to our dialogue.
content.trans: 但首先让我们听听对话。

content.text: The terrorists win.
content.trans: 恐怖分子获胜。

content.text: Mark, where have you been? I've been calling you all morning.
content.trans: Mark，你去哪儿了？我整个上午都在给你打电话。

content.text: I've been playing computer games.
content.trans: 我一直在玩电脑游戏。

content.text: What? So you blew me off yesterday and today over a stupid video game.
content.trans: 什么？所以你昨天和今天放我鸽子，就是为了一个蠢游戏？

content.text: What game is so important that you have no time for me anymore? What are you playing?
content.trans: 什么游戏这么重要，让你都没时间陪我了？你在玩什么？

content.text: It's called Counter Strike. It's a first person shooter game. It's awesome.
content.trans: 叫做《反恐精英》。这是一款第一人称射击游戏。太棒了。

content.text: It's a multiplayer game where you can go online and compete against players from all over the world.
content.trans: 这是一款多人游戏，你可以联网与来自世界各地的玩家对战。

content.text: You've been wasting your time on this? I can't believe it.
content.trans: 你就把时间浪费在这上面？我简直不敢相信。

content.text: It doesn't even look fun or challenging.
content.trans: 它甚至看起来并不好玩，也没什么挑战性。

content.text: My laptop is on my bed. If you think it's so easy then get online and try to beat me.
content.trans: 我的笔记本电脑在床上。如果你觉得这很容易，那就上线试试打败我。

content.text: Fine.
content.trans: 好啊。

content.text: Damn it! How are you killing me with a single shot? It's not fair.
content.trans: 该死！你怎么一枪就把我秒了？这不公平。

content.text: I don't want to play anymore. Let's go get something to eat.
content.trans: 我不玩了。我们去吃点东西吧。

content.text: Can you bring me something I'm totally hooked on this game?
content.trans: 你能给我带点吃的吗？我完全迷上这个游戏了。

content.text: Alright, we're back. There was some really interesting vocab here.
content.trans: 好了，我们回来了。这里有一些非常有趣的词汇。

content.text: Let's look at it now in Language Takeaway.
content.trans: 现在让我们在“语言要点”中看看它。

content.text: Language Takeaway.
content.trans: 语言要点。

content.text: What kind of a game was this?
content.trans: 这是一种什么样的游戏？

content.text: This game was a FPS or also in the dialogue we heard a first person shooter game.
content.trans: 这是一款FPS游戏，或者我们在对话中听到的“第一人称射击游戏”。

content.text: Our users might have heard this phrase first person before because it's a grammar term in many ways.
content.trans: 我们的用户之前可能听过“第一人称”这个短语，因为这在很多方面是一个语法术语。

content.text: We talk about I. I do this. I can sing as the first person.
content.trans: 我们谈论“我”。我做这个。我会唱歌。这就是第一人称。

content.text: But when we're talking about games first person shooter means that what you do you're doing as if you were the character in the game.
content.trans: 但当我们谈论游戏时，第一人称射击游戏意味着你所做的操作，就像你是游戏中的角色本人一样。

content.text: Right. So even the way that you're looking at the game it seems like you're looking through the eyes of the character.
content.trans: 没错。甚至你看游戏的视角，就像是透过角色的眼睛在看。

content.text: Okay, so you don't see the body. You are the body of the person.
content.trans: 好的，所以你看不到机身。你就是那个人的躯体。

content.text: You are the body. Exactly.
content.trans: 你就是机身。 exactly.

content.text: So first person shooter. So shooter obviously means that this is a shooting game.
content.trans: 所以是第一人称射击游戏。Shooter显然意味着这是一款射击游戏。

content.text: What you do is you pull the trigger, and shoot people.
content.trans: 你要做的就是扣动扳机，射击目标。

content.text: Exactly. And as we mentioned a lot of players are able to compete against each other.
content.trans: 没错。正如我们提到的，很多玩家能够相互竞争。

content.text: So it's called a multi-player game.
content.trans: 所以，它叫多人在线游戏。

content.text: Okay, so multi is a prefix because it goes at the beginning of a word in English that means many.
content.trans: 好的，multi是一个前缀，因为它放在英语单词的开头，意思是“很多”。

content.text: So you could hear multi-colored or multi-ethnic.
content.trans: 所以你能够听到多种颜色或多种民族的声音。

content.text: Right. And the meaning of this is that there are many different colors or many different ethnicities or in this case multi-player, many different players at the same time.
content.trans: 对。意思是有许多不同的颜色，或许多不同的种族，或者在这种情况下是“多人游戏”，即同时有许多不同的玩家。

content.text: Exactly. So in this game you can many players can play whether it's in a local area network or online over the internet.
content.trans: 没错。所以在这个游戏中，很多玩家可以一起玩，不管是在局域网还是通过互联网在线玩。

content.text: Cool. So you actually have to have the internet right when you're doing this because you're using many different computers so they have to be connected to each other.
content.trans: 真酷。所以你玩的时候确实需要有网络，因为你们使用的是许多不同的电脑，所以它们必须相互连接。

content.text: Right. So and that's our next word. You go online in order to play.
content.trans: 对。这就是我们的下一个词。你“上网（go online）”是为了玩游戏。

content.text: Okay. So online you've heard before online means on the internet.
content.trans: 好的。你以前听说过Online，意思是“在互联网上”。

content.text: But in this case the action of using the internet is called going online.
content.trans: 但在这个情况下，使用互联网的行为被称为上网。

content.text: So I want to go online to read my email.
content.trans: 比如我想上网查收我的电子邮件。

content.text: Right. Or I can't go online. I don't have a connection.
content.trans: 对。或者说“我上不了网，我没有网络连接”。

content.text: My mom will let me go online. I'm in trouble.
content.trans: 我妈不让我上网。我有麻烦了。

content.text: All right. So this is the way that you use it. You go online.
content.trans: 好的。这就是它的用法。你上网。

content.text: In order to use the internet you go online.
content.trans: 为了使用互联网，你需要go online（上网）。

content.text: Very interesting. Well the last word we've got here in language takeaway is very important one.
content.trans: 很有意思。我们在“语言要点”里的最后一个词非常重要。

content.text: We talk about video games because many people are in this situation. They're hooked on video games.
content.trans: 我们谈论电子游戏是因为很多人都处于这种情况。他们“迷上了（hooked on）”电子游戏。

content.text: Right. So if you are hooked on a video game or you are hooked on anything it means you're kind of addicted or you're very very interested in something.
content.trans: 对。如果你“hooked on”一个电子游戏或者任何东西，意味着你有点上瘾，或者你对某事非常非常感兴趣。

content.text: Exactly. So I'm hooked on the TV show Trueblood.
content.trans: 确实。我被《真血》这个电视节目迷上了。

content.text: Right. I love to watch it and I love every day I run home so I can watch it.
content.trans: 对。我爱看，我每天都跑回家为了看它。

content.text: But is there a game that you're hooked on Marco?
content.trans: 但是Marco，有没有哪款游戏让你着迷呢？

content.text: Currently I am hooked on a game called Guitar Hero Metallica.

content.text: Ooh fun. Yeah it's really fun.
content.trans: 噢，好玩。是啊，真的很有趣。

content.text: When I borrowed your PS3 I was hooked on bad company.

content.text: They're great games. It's very easy to get hooked on video games.
content.trans: 它们是很棒的游戏。人很容易沉迷于电子游戏。
